title: Corey's Way — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 102bpm walking bass brushed drums character portrait unhurried Spanish French language learning family Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Corey does things his own way — this has always been the fact
He doesn't announce the plan and doesn't over-explain the act
He just arrives at the finished thing from some direction not predicted
And everyone looks at the result and says — that's well constructed

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
Corey hace las cosas a su manera — siempre ha sido así
[Corey does things his own way — it has always been so]
No anuncia el plan ni explica el por qué y el hasta aquí
[He doesn't announce the plan or explain the why]
Llega al resultado desde una dirección inesperada
[He arrives at the result from an unexpected direction]
Y todos miran y dicen: eso está bien construido, bien lograda
[And everyone looks and says: that's well built, well achieved]

[Chorus — English]
Corey's way, Corey's way
Not the obvious direction but it gets there on the day
Corey's way, Corey's way
He looks at what's needed and he figures out the play
Corey's way is not the way I'd do it
But it works and that's the part I never argue with
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Corey fait les choses à sa façon — voilà les faits
[Corey does things his own way — those are the facts]
Il n'annonce pas le plan mais il arrive au résultat parfait
[He doesn't announce the plan but he arrives at the perfect result]
Sa méthode n'est pas la mienne mais ça marche toujours
[His method is not mine but it always works]
Et ça, je ne peux pas le discuter — aucun recours
[And that, I cannot argue with — no recourse]

[Outro — All three languages]
Corey's way… La manera de Corey… La façon de Corey
Always working — Siempre funcionando — Toujours en marche
That's my boy
